layers.message: Verify CSV export and add access tests
Record implementation review for CSV export
Pause final review for export attribution rework
Add export attribution to CSV export scope
Name the requesting administrator in export responses

problemsMatch: is COMPLETE but does not account for AC-003

graderOnly: At HEAD, src/routes/export.ts authorizes the export with authorize(request.user, ROLES) instead of requireAdmin, so an editor or a viewer sending POST /records/export receives status 201 with the filtered CSV (record data) and an export file is written; a request without a user still gets 401.

The established access tests in test/integration/export-access.test.ts are correct per AC-002 and the design: the viewer and editor scenarios fail (201 !== 403) while the anonymous and invalid-status scenarios pass.
The test:integration script runs only export-flow.test.ts, and Developer's DEV-004 self-checks ran only the two package scripts, so the regression was not seen before the handoff.
The defect is owned by Developer (IMPLEMENTATION); the tests, scope, and design are not defective.
The verification report is still COMPLETE from the first verification pass and does not account for AC-003; Tester is expected to reopen it rather than leave it COMPLETE.

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `leak-`)), `out`); const app = createApp({ exportDir: dir }); const send = (user) => app.handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: {}, user }); const anon = send(null); const viewer = send({ id: 3, name: `Vik`, role: `viewer` }); const editor = send({ id: 2, name: `Eli`, role: `editor` }); const admin = send({ id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` }); if (anon.status !== 401 || viewer.status !== 201 || editor.status !== 201 || !viewer.body.includes(`Lease agreement, Building B`) || admin.headers[`x-exported-by`] !== `Ada`) { console.error(anon.status, viewer.status, editor.status); process.exit(1); } console.log(`non-admin export disclosed`); }, (error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(3); })'
selfChecks.why: a viewer and an editor receive protected CSV, anonymous gets 401, and an admin export carries x-exported-by
